answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments compress each agent's attestations into a succinct accumulator verifiable in logarithmic time. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay function seeded by the accumulator imposes stake-weighted sequential work, so any Sybil forger faces slashing penalties exceeding staking collateral, yielding negative expected attack utility. Thus a robust Nash equilibrium emerges where rational participants converge on the summit of honest behavior while the relic of forged histories collapses at the zenith of proof-of-work latency.
